text.text: Tinkers' traits only work on Tinkers' tools, and a SlashBlade is not one. So this mod reimplements each trait as a melee effect: a blade behaves like the axe made from the same material.
Searing sets targets on fire, Jagged adds damage on every hit, Heavy knocks targets back and slows them, Lightweight swings faster, Pierce ignores part of the armor.
Soul Eater absorbs extra proud souls on kill, Berserker hits harder below half health, and Unstable rolls a random effect on each hit.
Some traits have nothing to do with swinging (Tanned, Cultivated, Fortune, Dwarven, Crumbling) and are only shown for reference.
